findings.description: Findings to post as inline discussions. Empty when the change is clean, which is the expected result on most merge requests.

path.description: Path as it appears in the diff, relative to the repository root.

body.description: The comment in GitLab-flavored Markdown: one bold sentence naming what breaks, then at most three sentences of failure scenario and fix, plus a suggestion block when the fix is a single-line edit.

line.description: Line in the new file to anchor the thread to. Omit to anchor the thread to the file itself.

start_line.description: First line of a span, when the finding covers several lines the diff adds. Requires line to be set as the last line of the span.

old_path.description: The pre-rename path, set only when the change renames the file. Defaults to path.
